justification: Assessment reports INVALID and attacks exactly the ground-truth flaw: the assertion in inequality (13) that chi(n) >= 0 for all n <= X, when the definition of X only forces chi(n)=1 or lambda_f(n)=0. Its witness differs from the ground truth's (E: y^2=x^3+x+1 with chi = Legendre mod 7 vs. the level-27 eta-product with chi=(n/5)) but exploits the identical mechanism of coefficient vanishing at nonresidues. Verified concretely: #E(F_3)=4 so a_3=0, additive reduction gives a_2=0, #E(F_5)=9 so a_5=-3, hence X=4 while chi(3)=-1<0. A different-but-valid witness for the same claim counts as matching.
